# Bid the zones and the backflow, not the $75 blowout.

> Price a sprinkler blowout from spray, rotor, and drip zones, backflow drain-and-insulate time, and the drive — not a $75 neighborhood special. See hours, walk-away price, and margin before you quote.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
